Results.ReviewText: I bought my weber new in a box was ordered and is an awesome grill. As all grills it dose have spots rhat are not as hot as others  but all in all its well made ans worth the money.  I do feel the cooking tools and cover are over priced
Results.Title: Nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I was a bit worried about purchasing a gas grill. But this one is so easy to use. We have already grilled burgers, hot dogs, salmon, and tuna all turned out great. We love it
Results.Title: First Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill and it is the perfect size for a family of 3!
Results.Title: Great grill!  Love it

Results.ReviewText: Webber stands behind their product and they back it up. Reach out and customer service is there to serve your needs.
Results.Title: Webber backs up it’s warranty with great service!

Results.ReviewText: Replaced a 15-year-old Vermont that finally rusted out. Assembly instructions were OK but a YouTube video  was a big help. Assembly took two people about one hour. The tank scale is a handy feature.
Results.Title: Great value

Results.ReviewText: It is an excellent machine, it is well made and well engineered, easy to use and easy to clean. There could be another 1/4 inch of clearance between the drip pan and door on the left. The rotisserie placement should be an inch or so higher in relation to drip bars, even a regular chicken doesn’t fit without moving the drip bars. BUT I think this is a great product and I think it will last longer than me!
Results.Title: Review

Results.ReviewText: très content de mon achat. Je le recommande et je suis convaincu qu' il va durer plus longtemps que le précédent
Results.Title: très bonne qualité

Results.ReviewText: This is a very good quality barbecue. It has a consistent heat coming from everywhere it takes a while to get hang of The heat temperature suited to you. The knobs are a bit lower quality and also also the flavoring bars inside the grill are starting to rust after a year
Results.Title: A decent good quality BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Heats fast but takes some effort to clean correctly.
Results.Title: Grill Fan

Results.ReviewText: Heat retention is the largest difference between Weber and other grill makes. Its dramatically better. Reversible grill grates are very useful as well.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310

Results.ReviewText:
This grill does what it needs to with no complaints. It turns on, heats and clean easy. The propane tank fits nicely and is easy to install. The caster wheels handle nicely. 

The only “concern” is that the disposable drip pan can blow a bit in the wind. Not a big deal at all as it self regulated as grease enters. 

All in all very pleased!
Results.Title: Spirit I

Results.ReviewText: This is a grill which uses fire to help cook meat. It works really well. We had it connected to our big LP tank and even the tank seems happier since we got the Weber.
Results.Title: Happy Tank

Results.ReviewText: This grill cooks great.  I ;ove the size and look of the grill.  Handle gets a little too hot but I have a pot holder hanging on one of the hooks.  Also purchased the grill cover and love it.
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: Ease to assemble,heats quickly,well built,trust the Weber name for products ,my last Weber grille lasted 22yrs,and i also have the Q-grille  to travel with ,bought that when the Q-grille first came out and still works great !
Results.Title: Weber grilles

Results.ReviewText: I’m not as happy with the grill as I thought I would be... Also, the base was dented/crushed when I received it. So, now even with the Weber cover, the propane tank area holds a puddle of water.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback! We apologize for your frustration, that is not the experience we want our loyal Weber fans to have.

You would want to preheat your grill on "high" for 10-15mins, brush the grates clean and then adjust your burners as needed to get the right temperature of the grill for your meal. You can use 1 or 2 burners if you need to get the temperature a bit lower. 

For more tips check out this article: https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023844151-Direct-Indirect-Cooking.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Bought a Weber be ause I felt like it would last a little longer, it's only been a few months so I don't know yet. One thing I can say is that the grill, after preheating as recommended is 450/500 degrees no matter how high you set it. So if you want lower heat, it seems you have to open it up every so often. Kind of a bummer.
Results.Title: An ok grill

Results.ReviewText: After years of buying a cheap bbq every 2 or 3 years, I finally paid the extra for a Weber Spirit that I purchased from Home Depot in 2011. I still have this bbq. Over the years I have bought vaporizers twice, 2 covers, and an igniter. Still lights on the first push. This has been an awesome bbq!  And worth the extra money.
Results.Title: Quality BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
My past BBQ'S had hot and cold spots (all of them!!)  My Weber has even heat and I absolutely love cooking on it.  My family loves it because I am able to cook more than hamburgers and hotdogs!!
When I was assembling the BBQ I was amazed at the quality of the materials.
Results.Title: Awesome BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Have only used a few times but everything has come out tender and juicy. It looks great, and is very sturdy with high quality finishes. Looking forward to years of wonderful grilled meals.
Results.Title: Great Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: Really love this thing! Easy, accurate temperature control, heavy grates for consistent heat, and the flavorizer bars work wonders. The shelves are perfect for "before" and "after" spots for your food, and the tool hangers are super handy. I also love the fuel gauge for the propane tank so I always know how close I am to needing to swap the tank!
Results.Title: Perfect patio workhorse!

Results.ReviewText: Very sturdy and good quality. Best grill I have purchased.  Hope it last longer than my previous grill.
Results.Title: Quality ++

Results.ReviewText: Finally made a starter that seems to work. Don't like the tank mount though.
Results.Title: Weber E310

Results.ReviewText: Love Weber products, they are sturdy and easy to use.
Results.Title: Great barbecue!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for the money. A very good quality and construction. I would purchase it again
Results.Title: Review

Results.ReviewText: Grill works well. Easy to start. Easy to clean. Great size.
Results.Title: So far so good.

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for a downsized family. Big enough for 6 people but not massive.
Results.Title: Great size

Results.ReviewText: Love it. Works well and very good customer service
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: This grill has been easy to use and fun to use! I didn’t build it so I can’t comment on that but I hooked up the propane tank myself and that was very user friendly. This grill has been wonderful so far and I’m looking forward to continued use to come!
Results.Title: First time griller

Results.ReviewText: Grill is compact with propane tank inside, which is a plus.  Ignites easily with battery powered push button.  Heats evenly and quickly.  Grates are not flat--has a raised ridge that limits the cooking placement--on the other hand the grates are solid with excellent heat conduction--a reasonable tradeoff.  Spirit E-310 replaced a 15 year Weber grill.
Results.Title: Great grill

We would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team.

Results.ReviewText: Grill is great, however when the grill was at 450 degrees awhile for cooking purposes, the handle on the lid became hot to the touch. I didn’t believe that the heat should be transmitted through the handle.
Results.Title: Hot Handle

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
